question: The normal cell of human being consists of 46 chromosomes, however, the germ cell has :
solution:
The correct answer is__ __**__23 chromosomes__ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Germ** **cell** : A cell that is developed into **reproductive** **cell**, which is an **egg** in female or an **sperm** in male.

 
• **Germ** **cell** consists **23** **chromosomes**, in the **zygote** **46** **chromosomes** or 23 pairs chromosomes present.
 
• Humans have **22** **pairs** of **autosomes** and **one** **pair** of **sex** **chromosomes** (**XX** or **XY**)
 
• Autosomes are numbered chromosomes that contain genes for anything that does not relate to sex determination.
 
• **chromosome 1 is the longest, and chromosome 22 is the shortest.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **DNA** stands for **deoxyribonucleic** **acid**.
 
• **DNA** is a long thin molecule made up of **nucleotides**.
 
• There are 4 different types of nucleotides - these are **adenine**, **thymine**, **cytosine**, and **guanine**, and each is represented by their first letter - **A,T,C,G ** **Nucleotides** are sometimes called bases.
